d: The Congress-Samajwadi Party alliance in Uttar Pradesh is facing fresh uncertainty ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has advised Imran Masood to focus more on work than public statements. However, Masood appears unwilling to step back from Congress's seat-sharing demands. While the SP has reportedly offered 26 seats, Congress is seeking more than 100. SP MP Rajiv Rai has argued that Congress stands to benefit more from contesting the elections in an alliance.
